t: This is the statue of Peter Pan in Kensington Gardens, made by the sculptor Sir George Frampton. Frampton was a leading figure in the New Sculpture movement, and he made many public monuments, including several statues of Queen Victoria and a number of war memorials after the First World War. His Edith Cavell Memorial in London and this Peter Pan statue are possibly his best known works, so you're standing in front of one of the two.
